Dear Matthieu Stigler,

Sorry for the unclear question. Thank you very much for taking the time to answer the questions.

Actually, I am quite new in the parallel computing and trying to implement foreach command that is placed in selectSETAR function, here are the commands and the error that I have on R for Windows,

> cl <- makeCluster(4, type="SOCK")

> registerDoSNOW(cl)

> opt=selectSETAR(x, m=4, d=1, thDelay=1,thVar=thvarx,trace=TRUE, include = c("const"),
               common=c("none"), nthresh=2, trim=0.15,
               criterion = c("SSR"), plot=TRUE,
               max.iter=3, same.lags=TRUE,
               restriction=c("none"), hpc=c("foreach"))

Using maximum autoregressive order for low regime: mL = 4 
Using maximum autoregressive order for high regime: mH = 4 
Using maximum autoregressive order for middle regime: mM = 4 

Using only first 14997 elements of thVar

Searching on 10455 possible threshold values within regimes with sufficient ( 15% ) number of observations
Searching on 10455 combinations of thresholds (10455) and thDelay (1) 

Error in { : task 1 failed - "could not find function "SSR_1thresh""


Best,

Sipan

messages.subject: Re: [tsDyn] parallel computing in selectSETAR and setar.test
parts:
Hi Siplan

Now I see the problem (although your example was still not directly reproducible, since we don't have the data you use!). I do not have the problem on my computer, but I guess the likely cause. I made a change in the development version, hosted on github. Could you please use that one, and let me know if the problem is solved?

For the dev version:
library(devtools)
install_github("tsDyn", ref="Dev94", username="MatthieuStigler", subdir="tsDyn")

note you might install Rtools if on windows, as package needs compiling c code.

Hope this helps

Matthieu
